patterns.title: Evidence-Grounded B2B Qualification, Brand-Aligned Proposals & Discount Gating
patterns.standard_playbook: Qualify B2B project dimensions, timelines, and specs (Suri), draft brand-synchronized proposals and bilingual campaigns (Mira), and keep every commercial figure traceable to approved price tables.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Never promise custom discounts, contractual terms, or delivery guarantees without explicit human operator approval.
